verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line saying platforms can bring their own KYC/KYB process or use Column's verifications with manual review. That hints at how onboarding decisions split between the platform and the bank, but says nothing about how an ops user works an application queue. Missing for 10: visibility into why an application is pending, a way to supply additional documents, an onboarding queue or dashboard workflow, explicit documentation of platform-versus-bank decision ownership, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
